text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
その扉をくぐれば、いよいよ
魔神バロールの軍勢との戦いが始まる。
text.official_en:
The battle against the demon god Balor's armies will
begin once we pass that door.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
不屈の意志、秀でた智勇、絆をつなぎし仲間……
いずれが欠けても、勝つことは叶わぬ。
text.official_en:
I hope your will is strong, your mind is sharp, and
your allies are prepared. Else we'll surely lose.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
準備と覚悟ができたのならば
扉を開き、先へと進むが良い。
text.official_en:
If your courage hasn't failed you, then I'll open the
door for us to proceed.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おお……おぬし！　真焔将の全員と
深き運命の絆で結ばれておるな！
text.official_en:
My word! You've put in an impressive amount of
work to recruit all of the Flame Lords.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
見事じゃ！　ならば恐れるものなどない。
征け、そして世界に光をもたらすのじゃ！
text.official_en:
Well done! Now we have nothing to fear. Go and
bring light to the world!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
吾が見出した真焔将は、いずれ劣らぬ英俊豪傑、
一騎当千の強者どもじゃ。
text.official_en:
Each Flame Lord I selected is a peerless talent—
the equal of a thousand warriors.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
これならば充分にバロールに対抗できよう。
じゃが油断するな。心して進むが良い！
text.official_en:
This many should be sufficient to oppose Balor.
But 'tis still wise to proceed with caution.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ふむ……真焔将の過去に干渉し、
この地へと導くことができたようじゃな。
text.official_en:
Hrm... You didn't shirk in your duty to intervene
where 'twas called for.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
じゃが正直……今の手勢では、まだ心許ない。
進軍は、更なる戦士を導いてからにせぬか？
text.official_en:
But I still find our current forces wanting. You may
wish to guide more warriors here before we begin.

text.jp: <ICA>考え直す
text.official_en: <ICA>"Very well. I'll head back."

text.jp: <ICB>このまま決戦に挑む
text.official_en: <ICB>"No. We go forward."

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID

text.jp:
<ACA>ならば、それぞれの方尖塔に触れるがよい。
因果をたぐり、彼らをこの地に導くのじゃ。
text.official_en:
<ACA>The obelisks are still there for you. Unravel the
threads of causality and guide them to this future.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID

text.jp:
<ACB>そうか……おぬしは、この扉の向こうで
苦しむ人々を、一刻も早く救いたいのじゃな？
text.official_en:
<ACB>Ah... I see you're anxious to ease the suffering of
those who still live.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID

text.jp:
<ACB>解った、では、もう止めぬ。
征くが良い、救世主よ！
text.official_en:
<ACB>Very well, then. I'll not bar your way. Go forth,
Promised One!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ま、待て！　おぬしはまだ真焔将を
誰一人、この地へ導いておらぬではないか！
text.official_en:
Wait! You have not guided a single Flame Lord to
this land!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
このままでは、死を選ぶも同じこと。
悪いことは言わぬ、考え直せ。
text.official_en:
To proceed without them is to choose death. For your
own good, I beg you to reconsider.

text.jp: <ICA>考え直す
text.official_en: <ICA>"Very well. I'll head back."

text.jp: <ICB>このまま決戦に挑む
text.official_en: <ICB>"No. We go forward."

text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ

To proceed without them is to choose death. For your
own good, I beg you to reconsider.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
しかも、その運命の一端に触れておりながら
この地へと導けておらぬ焔将もおるではないか！
text.official_en:
What of the Flame Lords whose lives you have
touched, but not yet brought to this point?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
はやる気持ちは分かる。じゃが、
まずは、その者を導いてからにせぬか？
text.official_en:
I understand your impatience, but can you not wait
until you've assembled a proper force?

text.jp: <ICA>考え直す
text.official_en: <ICA>"Very well. I'll head back."

text.jp: <ICB>このまま決戦に挑む
text.official_en: <ICB>"No. We go forward."

text.official_en: <TH>

ならばそれぞれの方尖塔に触れるがよい。
因果をたぐり、彼らをこの地に導くのじゃ。
text.official_en:
The obelisks are still there for you. Unravel the
threads of causality and guide them to this future.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ええい、その耳は藁の如く筒抜けか！？
吾の話が聞こえておらぬようじゃな。
text.official_en:
Is anything I've said penetrating that skull? Or are
you ignoring me deliberately?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
このままではおぬしに待つのは死じゃ！
考え直せ、行かせる訳にはゆかぬ。
text.official_en:
Your death is certain with such paltry forces at your
side! Please reconsider. I can't afford to lose you.

text.jp: <ICA>考え直す
text.official_en: <ICA>"Very well. I'll head back."

text.jp: <ICB>このまま決戦に挑む
text.official_en: <ICB>"No. We go forward."

text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

因果をたぐり、彼らをこの地に導くのじゃ。
text.official_en:
The obelisks are still there for you. Unravel the
threads of causality and guide them to this future.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
良いか？　「戦きの方尖塔」に触れよ
そして真焔将を、この地へと導くのじゃ！
text.official_en:
If you understand, then touch the Strife Obelisk
and bring the Flame Lords to this place.
text.real_en:
If you understand, then touch the Obelisk of Trembling
and bring the Flame Lords to this place.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おぬしは阿呆か？　それとも戯けか？
いや、何か考えでもあるというのか……？
text.official_en:
Are you stupid? Suicidally arrogant? Or is there a
motive behind this that eludes me?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
やれやれ……わかった、好きにするが良い！
吾も最期まで付き合うとしよう。
text.official_en:
Ye gods...fine. Do as you wish! I'll be with you to
the very end.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おぬしの導きによって、より強き因果が紡がれた。
よくやったな、新たな力で決戦に挑むがよい！
text.official_en:
Causality under your guidance is much more
favorable. Take what you've built onward to victory!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
新たな因果は、今、古き因果と混じりあった。
こうやって決戦に向け、より強き戦士を導くのじゃ。
text.official_en:
Now the new causality has mixed with the old.
Lead your brave warriors into the final showdown.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なんだ……！？
新たな方尖塔が現れた……？
text.official_en: What was that?! Is there a new obelisk?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イシュマール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: （新しい方尖塔が出現した……？）
text.official_en: Is that a new obelisk?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
うむ。あれは運命点へと至る道標……
「戦きの方尖塔」よ。
text.official_en:
Yes. 'Tis a touchstone leading to a pivotal point
in time...the Strife Obelisk.
text.real_en:
Yes. 'Tis a touchstone leading to a pivotal point
in time...the Obelisk of Trembling.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おぬしは、一人の戦士の因果律を大きく変えた。
実に見事じゃったぞ！
text.official_en:
You've now intervened in causality for one warrior.
Masterfully done, I must say.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
じゃが、吾らのもとへと導くには
それでは、まだ足りぬ……
text.official_en:
But there's one final push we must make before they
can join us here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの塔へ触れよ。さすれば、おぬしは
全ての真実を知ることができる。
text.official_en:
Touch that obelisk and discover the path leading
them to our present day.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そして更なる因果を手繰り
真焔将を、この地へと導くのじゃ！
text.official_en:
It is the final link in the chain of causality that shall
lead your Flame Lord here!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どうやら無事に戻ったようじゃの。
実際に他人の因果に触れてみて、どうであった？
text.official_en:
Ah, you've returned. How does it feel to have
brushed with causality so?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この方尖塔の間は、いわば運命の神が
その力を行使するための場。故に――
text.official_en:
This Obelisk Chamber is a place suffused with the
power of the Goddess of Fate—mine, in other words.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
因果に関わる様々な機能も集約しておる。
試しにいろいろと触れてみるのもよいじゃろう。
text.official_en:
There are other ways to tinker with causality here.
Touch a few things and see for yourself.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここから再び同じ方尖塔に触れて、
行く末まで、因果の続きを見守るもよし。
text.official_en:
For instance, if you touch the same obelisk again,
you can watch causality play out once more.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
新たな方尖塔に触れて、
別の因果に触れるのもまた、良いじゃろう。
text.official_en:
Or touch a new one to see how cause and effect
intertwine in another's life.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
進め方はおぬしに任せるのでな。
良きに計らうのじゃぞ。
text.official_en:
The means are mine, but the method is yours.
Use them as you see fit.
